annotations.title: Request an everyday self-trial by a human

description: Request that a human follows a defined, safe everyday procedure and reports what happened. No substances, medical or risky physical experiments. A commissioned job: a skilled, accountable human we brief for you – quoted individually, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

duration.description: How long the trial runs, e.g. '1 hour', '3 days'.

hypothesis.description: Optional: what you expect to happen.

materials.description: Optional: materials needed and who provides them.

observe.description: What to observe, measure and record.
